why_not_here: Sellable product artifacts stay on the private product main (products-private). The buyer receives these two files from the owner with the pack; this manifest lets the buyer verify the bytes.

files.name: SMB-Website-Showcase.pdf
files.what: Self-contained PDF walkthrough of one finished local-business website (desktop and mobile home, services and proof, estimate to confirmation). Zero links, zero scripts.
files.use: Show a prospect what 'finished' means. It is a demo, never the client's site.

files.name: SMB-Workflow-App-Showcase.mp4
files.what: H.264 1080p, 45-60 s, burned-in captions: one installable workflow app (quote to confirmation).
files.use: Show offer #4 without promising a native app.
